mapper.select: SELECT seq, id, title, content, regdate, refer, step, depth, readcount,delflag FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY refer DESC,step ASC) rn, seq, id, title, content, regdate, refer, step, depth,readcount,delflag FROM answerboard ) a WHERE ceil(rn/10) = #{pnum}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO answerboard VALUES(NULL,#{id},#{title},#{content},SYSDATE(), (SELECT nvl(MAX(refer),0)+1 FROM answerboard) ,0,0,0,'N')
